title: Rubric Forge
one_liner: Turns a list of your real work tasks into a scored benchmark spec and a side-by-side scoring sheet.
headline: Paste the tasks your team actually does, get an editable weighted benchmark spec and a click-to-score grid comparing up to four AI models, exportable as JSON or CSV.

episode.title: Big Tech’s $3T AI Bet, Claude Writes 90% of Anthropic’s Code, AIs Editing AI Brains | EP #308

history.summary: Rubric Forge is a tight, faithful build of the episode's "build a benchmark for your real work" pitch and a genuinely usable version of the Yardstick Works opportunity: paste tasks, get an editable spec table, score models pass/partial/fail, watch weighted bars update live, and export. All five acceptance criteria check out against the code and the manual-check screenshots, the three podcast figures are verified and correctly attributed, and the example/illustrative data is clearly badged throughout. No dead buttons, no console errors, no external dependencies at all — a solid, publishable prototype.
